design.status_of_evidence: the HS-Stroke data and pairs were examined in G3 with TS+LR; EEGNet outcomes on them have never been computed (R4's EEGNet run was stopped with no outcome). New-model evidence on the same participants: not an independent cohort.
design.model: R4/Paper A EEGNet-8,2 exactly (vendored make_eegnet: kern 64 at 128 Hz, F1 8, D 2, F2 16, dropout 0.25, max-norm 1/0.25, Adam 1e-3, batch 64, 100 epochs, no early stopping/validation); R4 input (4-40 Hz causal Butterworth, MI window 9-13 s, 128 Hz x 512, per-trial channel z-score); no tuning
design.implementation: grouped exact equivalent of separate fits (tests/test_r6_c2_synthetic.py); FFT/einsum fast path equals the convolution path; torch deterministic algorithms
design.pairs: per (participant, fold) task an outcome-blind simple random ceil(n/3) of the G3 seed-42 pairs (rng [7301, 42, participant, fold])
design.arms: A = C + a', B = C + b'; G = C + g' (G3 C1 neighbour) where defined; C/E = C + c'/e' (G3 C2 placebo) where defined; one A/A duplicate per task
design.common_random_numbers: all arms of a pair share init (torch.manual_seed(pair seed) on make_eegnet), row order and dropout masks; pair seed = sha256(7302, 42, participant, fold, k)
design.estimands: G3 formulas and aggregation (correct-class softmax probability; class-balanced within participant; 14 participants equal weight; t95 CI; exact sign-flip; Holm over S1-S5)
design.fail_closed: non-finite output, A/A mismatch > 0, missing group or commitment mismatch -> BLOCKED, no analysis of partial results

hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H1_primary: d_EEGNet (canonical base, sampled pairs) differs from 0; two-sided exact sign-flip over 14 participants
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H2_direction_declared_before_fit: d_EEGNet > d_TSLR on the same pairs (S5 > 0): a deep decoder trained to low loss is expected to carry more self-influence than an L2 linear model
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold

amendment: v1.1 (implementation only, before any outcome): the v1 attempt stopped BLOCKED with CUDA out-of-memory at the evaluation step of group 1 (owner GPU processes grew to leave 1.3 GB free; evaluation used chunks of 256 trials x 96 models). Changes: evaluation chunks 32; GPU cap 7.5 GB; on out-of-memory the group is discarded, memory freed, resources awaited and the identical deterministic group recomputed (<= 6 times).
